title: Bỏ marker khỏi AGENTS bootstrap và tăng patch version
goal: Generated project AGENTS.md không còn lộ marker Harnix, đồng thời package phát hành patch version mới.
nonGoals: Thay đổi marker của Codex user-global managed block.
Thay đổi nội dung workflow ngoài marker bootstrap.
Thay đổi major hoặc minor version.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Project AGENTS bootstrap không chứa harnix begin/end markers và vẫn giữ hướng dẫn Harnix.
Codex global managed selector vẫn dùng marker để reconciliation an toàn.
Package version và changelog phản ánh patch version 0.6.1.
Focused template tests, lint và typecheck pass.

validationPlan.description: Run project bootstrap and Codex global template regression tests.
validationPlan.command: pnpm exec vitest run test/workflow/templates.test.ts test/platform/codex-global.test.ts

validationPlan.description: Run lint and typecheck after template and metadata changes.

evidence.summary: New regression assertion reproduced begin/end markers in the generated project AGENTS bootstrap.
Generated project bootstrap passed explicit no-marker assertions while retaining Harnix instructions.
Codex global template tests passed, preserving the independent marker-based selector used for safe global reconciliation.
Inspected package.json and CHANGELOG.md: release metadata is patch version 0.6.1 with its documented bootstrap-marker change.
Focused template suite passed 4 tests; lint and typecheck both passed.
